breakdown.description: The prescribed global x-directed shear traction is replaced by a boundary-normal pressure on the slope
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. It states 'Treat the sloping-edge load as a uniform inward normal pressure of magnitude 2000 Pa' and computes the traction as T = 2000 * (-1/sqrt(5), -2/sqrt(5)), which is a boundary-normal pressure. The ground truth requires a global x-directed traction T = (2000, 0) Pa, not a normal pressure. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
